name: e3_routing_mixed
description: E3: 10 multi-step taxi conversations (3-5 turns) sharing one long system prefix and growing history; run under least_loaded vs prefix_then_load via --policy-override. Gateway needs ALLOW_EXPERIMENT_CONTROLS=1. The shared system prefix (~6k tokens) is large relative to per-turn history so every turn stays above the gateway's 0.8 prefix-overlap threshold (with max_tokens 128). max_tokens is 128 so the worst-case context stays within the workers' 8192 max-model-len.
